creation.entry.keju_mingjing.zh: 科举 · 明经科（帖经、墨义，取中较易）
creation.entry.keju_mingjing.en: Examinations: Classicist track (passage completion and written explication of the classics; easier to pass)

creation.entry.keju_jinshi.zh: 科举 · 进士科（诗赋、策问，难而清贵）
creation.entry.keju_jinshi.en: Examinations: Presented Scholar track (poetry and rhapsody composition plus policy essay questions; hard but prestigious)

creation.entry.toujun.zh: 投军 · 折冲府应募，队正起步
creation.entry.toujun.en: Enlist: join an Assault-resisting Garrison, starting as Squad Leader

protagonist.mingjing.role.zh: 无名县衙小吏，以推理与人脉立身
protagonist.mingjing.role.en: A nameless county clerk who lives by deduction and connections

protagonist.mingjing.blurb.zh: 他把县狱的每一桩旧案都读成了书。上官说他眼里揉不得沙子，同僚说他迟早惹祸——直到那桩丝帛血案摆上案头。
protagonist.mingjing.blurb.en: He has read every old case in the county jail like scripture. His superiors say his eyes tolerate no grain of sand; his colleagues say he will bring trouble on himself sooner or later—until the silk-and-blood case lands on his desk.

protagonist.baishen.role.zh: 一介布衣，可科举可投军；唯一可自由分配四维
protagonist.baishen.role.en: A plain commoner; sit the examinations or enlist—the only origin with free attribute allocation

protagonist.baishen.blurb.zh: 一介布衣，无门第可倚。长安米贵，居大不易——可这满城朱紫，哪一个不是从青袍熬起？
protagonist.baishen.blurb.en: A commoner with no clan at your back. Rice is dear in Chang'an and living is hard—yet every crimson and purple robe in this city once sweated its years out in cyan.

protagonist.shuzu.role.zh: 边镇无名士兵，抗吐蕃、后突厥，军功叙迁
protagonist.shuzu.role.en: A nameless frontier soldier facing the Tibetan Empire (Tufan) and the Second Türk Khaganate, rising by battlefield merit

protagonist.shuzu.blurb.zh: 大非川的雪埋过同袍的靴子。军功簿上你的名字写了又涂，涂了又写——这一回，得让它留下来。
protagonist.shuzu.blurb.en: The snows of Dafeichuan buried your comrades' boots. Your name has been written into the merit rolls and struck out, again and again—this time it must stay.

protagonist.nvguan.role.zh: 掖庭宫人，以文才与宫廷博弈升迁，可参预机要
protagonist.nvguan.role.en: A woman of the Palace Domestic Service, rising by literary gift and court maneuvering, with a hand in confidential affairs

protagonist.nvguan.blurb.zh: 掖庭的灯火熄得最晚。你替人抄经、代人拟表，字迹清峻如刀——迟早有一日，它会落到该看见它的人眼里。
protagonist.nvguan.blurb.en: Lamps burn latest in the Palace Domestic Service. You copy sutras and draft memorials for others, in a hand clean and sharp as a knife—one day it will fall under the eyes meant to see it.

protagonist.hushang.role.zh: 西市粟特商贾，金钱起点高而无官身；可纳资或以情报换官
protagonist.hushang.role.en: A Sogdian trader of the Western Market—rich in coin, empty of rank; office may be had by contribution or by traded intelligence

protagonist.hushang.blurb.zh: 从撒马尔罕到西市，三万里驼铃。你数得清每一枚开元通宝的成色，也听得见每一句不该听见的话。
protagonist.hushang.blurb.en: From Samarkand to the Western Market, thirty thousand li of camel bells. You can grade every Kaiyuan Tongbao coin by touch—and hear every word you were never meant to hear.

save.error.corrupt.zh: 存档受损，已停止读取。绝不带着缺损的档继续——那比读档失败更糟。
save.error.corrupt.en: The save file is damaged, so loading was stopped. We never continue on a broken save—that is worse than failing to load.

save.error.too_new.zh: 此存档来自更新版本的游戏，请更新后再读取。
save.error.too_new.en: This save comes from a newer version of the game. Update the game to load it.

save.error.migration_missing.zh: 存档版本无法迁移。这是程序缺陷，请向我们报告。
save.error.migration_missing.en: This save version cannot be migrated. This is a bug on our side—please report it.
